subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md/bootstrap budget enforcement now, and should archive behavior live here or in the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation, but the remaining request changes workspace-file editing and persistent memory lifecycle behavior rather than repairing a single broken code path.

options.title: Define a narrow Control UI contract
options.body: Add an editor budget meter and explicit warning/blocking for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and use this issue only for the UI case after that direction is approved.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Declare prompt, doctor, and /context diagnostics sufficient for now and close the save-enforcement/archive request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow Control UI contract
recommendation.body: Add an editor budget meter and explicit warning/blocking for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across bootstrap truncation handling and the Agents dashboard/file editing surface.
